entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I, uh, I think I need to return something. I bought this jersey and the whole process is just so confusing. I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please get your order number?
Oh, sure. It's... VF-8675309. It's for the ClubFit Jersey. It's just the wrong size for me.

Thank you. I have your order pulled up. I can see you received the jersey about 36 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's just... it's too tight. The sizing chart on the website was a little overwhelming, and I guess I picked the wrong size. I wanted to do an exchange, but I couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Your jersey is a standard item, and it falls within our 90-day return window, so you're all set. We can definitely get that processed for you.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I was stuck with it. That's a relief.
Not a problem at all. I can process an exchange for the correct size right now, or I can issue a return for a full refund. Which would you prefer?
An exchange would be perfect! I'd love to get a size up.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange request for you. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Please use that to send back the original jersey, and we'll ship the new size as soon as the return is processed. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much for making that so easy, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
